subject: english
topic: Oral English: rhymes (choose the word that rhymes with the given word)

q.q: Choose the word that rhymes with the given word: BLEED
q.explanation: BLEED is pronounced /bliːd/ and rhymes with reed /riːd/. The other options have different vowel sounds or extra endings.

q.q: Choose the word that rhymes with the given word: GROAN
q.explanation: GROAN is pronounced /groʊn/, matching known /noʊn/. The others contain different vowel sounds such as /ɒ/ or /aʊ/ or a diphthong /ɔɪ/.

q.q: Choose the word that rhymes with the word in capitals: PLOUGH
q.explanation: PLOUGH is pronounced /plaʊ/, the same vowel sound as bough /baʊ/. Though, cough and dough all have different vowel sounds despite similar spelling.

q.q: Choose the word that rhymes with the given word: HEIGHT
q.explanation: HEIGHT is pronounced /haɪt/, which rhymes with white /waɪt/. Weight has a different vowel sound /eɪ/, so it does not match.

q.q: Choose the word that rhymes with the word in capitals: WORM
q.explanation: WORM is pronounced /wɜːm/, which matches firm /fɜːm/. Warm and form have the vowel sound /ɔː/, which is different.

q.q: Choose the word that rhymes with the word in capitals: GAUGE
q.explanation: GAUGE is pronounced /geɪdʒ/, matching cage /keɪdʒ/. Gorge and huge contain different vowel sounds, /ɔː/ and /juː/ respectively, so they do not rhyme.

q.q: Choose the word that rhymes with the given word: SOOT
q.explanation: SOOT is pronounced /sʊt/ with a short vowel, matching foot /fʊt/. Suit, boot and shoot all have the long vowel sound /uː/, so they do not rhyme with soot.

q.q: In standard British pronunciation, choose the word that rhymes with the given word: ISLE
q.explanation: ISLE is pronounced /aɪl/, with a silent 's', matching mile /maɪl/. Aisle sounds identical to isle itself, so it cannot be the rhyming partner being sought, as the task requires a different word with the same sound.
